# R6.36 — E2-T2(b)/E2-T4(a): compiled `tools[]` + completion surface + `tool_choice`; typed `json_head_tail@1`/`text_head_tail@1` + `error_format` classes (manifest 294)

Harness: devin-cli / swe-2-high / subagent — engineered (offline, $0.00)

Offline-only, zero-spend ticket extending R6.35's **one** compiled-`ModelSurface`
renderer (never a second, CC1). Stage 1 (commit `41996739`) renders `tools[]`
from `ModelSurface.tools` and arms `hh.submit`/`tool_choice` only when declared
(REQ-XE-105/106). Stage 2 (commit `f99c04d1`) lands AR-23's pure typed
renderers — `json_head_tail@1`/`text_head_tail@1` (REQ-XE-110) and the
`error_format` typed format-failure classes (REQ-XE-111) — in
`hharness_compiler::result_render`, the one pure home (CC10); live wiring is
R6.37. No spend, no live claims, no `spec/` edits.

## Stage 1 — E2-T2 (b) (commit `41996739`)

- **`GatewayModel::render_tools` — armed path.** `tools[]` walks
  `ModelSurface.tools` (`CompiledToolSurface`): wire name =
  `wire_name(binding.surface_name)`, description = the compiled
  `description`, `parameters` = the compiled `schema` (the capability
  `input_schema` projected at lower) — **carried verbatim**, member
  descriptions included; the legacy `ParamSpec` re-derivation never runs
  (REQ-XE-105). `wire_to_surface` maps wire name → `binding.surface_id`.
- **Completion surface (REQ-XE-106, G4).** `completion_surface_arm(doc)`
  reads the `control_strategy` slot params (same read discipline as
  `model_port_slot_params`): `completion_surface` member — `"none"` ⇒
  suppressed, `"hh.submit"` ⇒ armed, other ⇒ typed `InvalidDefinition`;
  absent ⇒ derived from `stop_rule` — `submit` (string or the amended
  `{submit:{…}}` object form — the marker rule, REQ-XE-116's family)
  needs no claim surface ⇒ unarmed; `no_action`/`either` ⇒ armed;
  absent ⇒ the variant preset (`submit`). Unknown spellings refuse
  typed, never silently coerce.
- **`ArmedSurface{surface, completion_armed}`** rides the session
  (`SessionState.model_surface`, `CarriedRuntime`) — computed at
  `arm_model_surface`, re-derived by the same read in
  `resume_model_surface` (never persisted, CC1).
  `GatewayModel::with_completion_arm(bool)` applies it; armed ⇒ the
  `hh_submit` entry renders the same bytes the legacy path emits.
- **`tool_choice`** stays R6.34's opt-in member (`auto`/`omit`) — sent
  only when declared `auto` or omitted when `omit`; absent ⇒ the
  family's `auto` default (legacy bytes unchanged).

## Stage 2 — E2-T4 (a) (commit `f99c04d1`)

- **`ResultRenderSpec.renderer`** (absent-not-null, CC8) gains the typed
  renderers: `JsonHeadTail{threshold, head, tail, unit ∈ {chars,
  utf8_bytes}, fields[], json_style ∈ {python_jinja_tojson, canonical}}`
  and `TextHeadTail{threshold, head, tail, unit, marker: Text}`. The
  `result_renderer{kind: "…@1"}` authored member / `result_render`
  profile rule params compile through `compile_typed_renderer` — typed
  refusals for unknown kinds/units/styles, a non-one `truncate` field,
  and a marker whose `hh-tmpl/1` variables exceed `{threshold, head,
  tail, unit, omitted}` (UnexpressibleSurface — strict undefined's
  compile half).
- **`hh-compiler::result_render`** — the pure module (no clock/env/host
  reads): `render_json_head_tail` emits mini's pretty object —
  `{\n  "f": v` required newline members, `, "f": v` inline optional
  members, `measure ≥ threshold` expands the truncate field to
  `{name}_head/{name}_tail/elided_chars (= measure − threshold, the
  template's own arithmetic)/warning`. `python_jinja_tojson` implements
  Python `json.dumps` + Jinja htmlsafe escapes (`<>&'` → `\uXXXX`,
  `ensure_ascii` incl. surrogate pairs) — X-08's declared spelling;
  goldens are `provenance: hand_derived` until O-recorded bytes land
  (REQ-XE-114). `utf8_bytes` slices decode lossily (`U+FFFD` —
  Python's `errors="replace"`). `render_text_head_tail` emits
  head + marker + tail with `omitted = measure − threshold`.
- **`ErrorFormatSpec.classes`** (absent-not-null) carries
  `FormatErrorClasses{renderings: map<FormatFailureClass, Text>, scope}` —
  the five classes `no_tool_calls`, `args_unparseable{error}`,
  `unknown_tool{name}`, `missing_param{name}`,
  `output_truncated{finish_reason}`; each leaf's `hh-tmpl/1` variables
  must ⊆ the class's declared slots at compile.
  `render_response_errors` renders per class under `per_call`, the first
  failure only under `batch` (REQ-XE-111's batch scope).
- **Codec:** `schema.rs` `error_spec/result_spec` round-trips gain the
  new members — absent-not-null both directions (CC8); `s3_9` literals
  updated.

## Tests

- `crates/hh-compiler/tests/r6_36.rs` — **8/8**: `json_head_tail@1`
  goldens (under-threshold + exception_info inline leg; 9 999 / 10 000 /
  10 001 boundary leg with `elided_chars = len − 10 000`; head/tail
  edges); `utf8_bytes` multi-byte boundary (`\ufffd`) and `chars`
  scalar measure; typed-param leg (a `threshold` member edit — never a
  template edit — moves the cut); `text_head_tail@1` golden (Terminus
  marker, `omitted` fill, chars unit); per-class `error_format` goldens
  + `NoRendering` refusal + `batch` scope (one render per response);
  compile legs (typed members land; bad kind / zero-truncate / undeclared
  marker var / unknown class refusals). Goldens are
  `provenance: hand_derived` (REQ-XE-114) — never evidence.
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/r6_36.rs` — **6/6**: AC-1 `tools[]` ==
  `BASH_TOOL` golden + member-description carry + description-mutation
  leg; AC-2 ±completion × ±tool_choice matrix (the `hh_submit` entry is
  byte-identical to the legacy render), `stop_rule = submit` + no
  completion ⇒ no `hh_submit` leg, the declaration-read battery
  (`none`/`hh.submit`/derive/refusals), the legacy golden unchanged;
  AC-5 the opt-in pin.
- **Regression:** all `hharness-compiler` + `hharness-embed` suites
  green (incl. r6_34 6/6, r6_35 4/4+9/9); `cargo fmt --all --check`
  clean; `cargo tree -p hharness-compiler` unchanged — no new
  dependency (stdlib only); `git diff --stat -- spec/` empty.

## Deviations

- `stop_rule` absent ⇒ the armed variant's preset (`submit` — the only
  value `StrategyParams::default()` produces); G11's full slot-param
  decode stays its own ticket's scope.
- `completion_surface` admits `{none, hh.submit}`; other names refuse
  typed (a named claim-surface member is a later ticket's spelling).
- `elided_chars`/`omitted` = `measure − threshold` — the O templates'
  literal arithmetic (equals `measure − head − tail` when
  `head + tail = threshold`, mini's and Terminus's shape).
- Host capabilities are not compiled surfaces — they stay off the armed
  path's `tools[]` (a mini-shaped run declares none; the compiled
  document's capabilities are the source, REQ-XE-105).
- `python_jinja_tojson` goldens are hand-derived (X-08 caveat stands).
